text:
alex: Follow-up on the SLA-weighted soft-admit idea. proposing a compact admission API that returns {allow|degrade|retry|reject} plus action_reason and optional fallback_model.
nora: Love it. Thinking about decision input: tenant_sla_weight, short_window_rps, token_variance, prompt_reuse_score, and a lightweight entropy heur. keep ML out of hot path initially.
deep: Agree. Hybrid placement: sidecar enforces deterministic caps and applies immediate allow/deny. central admission returns scored suggestions and coordinates fallbacks. sidecar honors central only when healthy.
alex: Policy defaults: if central unreachable -> permissive for sla_weight>=0.8, conservative for sla_weight<0.2, and probabilistic degrade for middle. Configurable.
nora: Degrade actions: prefer model downgrade, then max_tokens reduction, then 429. Also add a header for transparency: X-Fairness-Action.
deep: Telemetry must include route, tenant_hash, sla_weight, abuse_score (if present), chosen_action, latency_delta_estimate. expose score_debug in traces during dry-run.
alex: Probation state machine per tenant_id: counts degradations in window -> escalate -> decay. prevents oscillation.
nora: Simulation plan: replay past month of traffic through candidate policy in dry-run and compute FPR on top 200 tenants and revenue/latency delta. Gate: dry-run FPR < 1% and <0.5% latency regressions for top 50 tenants.
deep: Security: store hashed prompt fingerprints in audit trail, keep raw prompts out of central logs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for soft-admit sidecar v0.1 to infra/canary at 08:30 PT :white_check_mark:
alex: I'll draft the RFC patch with config proto and rollout gates. nora, deep: assign ownership for telemetry and state machine.
nora: I'll own telemetry + observability. deep: i'll prototype the probation logic.
alyx: (typo) alex: thanks all, sync tomorrow 11am to finalize API shapes.
